limits.en: The .001m mean-depth contour differs from the analytic support edge, which is reported separately. These fixed runs test wetting of initially dry cells. Retreating shorelines, re-drying cycles, real floods, friction and moving fronts over topography are outside scope. The initial100/200/400-cell [-5,5]m attempt passed28 tests and105/109 gates; three retained-dry-cell gates and the .3960m>.25m contour error failed. All original records remain archived; revision2 enlarges/refines the input without changing acceptance. Revision2 then stopped on a binary64 subnormal-tail dry-momentum artifact. Revision3 factors the same HLL update into water packets and adds three regression/equivalence tests; the original28 remain unchanged. Revision3 passed108/109 gates but failed the .27415m>.25m contour criterion. Revision4 refines only Ritter grids to1600/3200/6400. Relative depth L1 is normalized by domain reference mass; absolute L1 is also retained because the domain changed between revisions1 and2.

reference_note.ja: 全段の水深min、新たに濡れた初期乾セル数、残る乾セル数、境界流束を含む質量・運動量収支を保存します。Ritterのhとhuをファン端で分割したGauss8セル平均と比較し、Gauss16・全質量・PDE残差で参照を確認。3格子L1細分化とh≥.001mの最右セル中心を検査します。 水深L1の合否は初回と同じ固定参照質量5m²で正規化し、領域を広げたことによる基準の緩和を防ぎます。領域全体の相対L1は別の診断です。
reference_note.en: Record all FE minima, newly wetted and remaining dry cells, boundary-aware mass/momentum budgets, and L1 refinement. Split Gauss8 h/hu references are qualified by Gauss16, mass and PDE identities. Diagnose the rightmost cell center with mean h>=.001m. Depth acceptance uses the original fixed5m2 reference mass, preventing domain extension from weakening the criterion; full-domain relativeL1 remains a separate diagnostic.

caption.ja: 保存した最細Re100計算の流線と速さ。赤点は格子上の主渦、白抜き点はGhia表Vの主渦位置です。
caption.en: Saved finest Re100 streamlines and speed. Red dot: computed grid primary vortex; hollow dot: original Ghia TableV location.

note.ja: 一定密度・粘性の代表形。周期2D MAC射影・Taylor–Green渦に加え、圧力を消去する非周期Re100キャビティを別配布で検証します。
note.en: Representative constant-density/viscosity flow. In addition to periodic2D MAC projection/Taylor–Green, a separate release verifies a pressure-eliminated nonperiodic Re100 cavity.

note.ja: 格子単位Δx=Δt=1の衝突・並進更新。D2Q9等温・低Mach数のせん断波とPoiseuille流を扱います。
note.en: Collision/streaming in lattice units Δx=Δt=1. Examples cover D2Q9 isothermal low-Mach shear waves and Poiseuille flow.

equation_note.ja: 無次元の単位正方形、ν=.01、蓋速度U=1、Re=100。上面の内部節点だけu=1、他壁と四隅の速度は0、全壁ψ=0。初期内部渦度は0。壁渦度はThom条件で各Heun段に再設定します。
equation_note.en: Dimensionless unit square, viscosity.01, lid speed1, Re100. Top interior nodes haveu1; other walls and all four corners have zero velocity. Psi0 on every wall; initial interior vorticity0. Reapply Thom wall vorticity at every Heun stage.

name.ja: Re=100蓋駆動キャビティ：Ghia中心線との比較
name.en: Re100 lid-driven cavity: Ghia centerline comparison

note.en: Advance genuine four-wall BGK flow on three fixed grids, checking nominal-lid Ghia centerlines, primary vortex, stationarity and wall momentum budgets.

title.ja: Ghia Re100：原著の有限格子速度中心線
title.en: Ghia Re100: original finite-grid velocity centerlines

references.formula: u_ref(.5,y_j),v_ref(x_j,.5): original TablesI/II Re100; primary vortex(x,y)=(.6172,.7344): TableV.

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形、Re100、蓋速度1、他壁静止。Ghia原著の表I/IIのRe100列から速度u(0.5,y)とv(x,0.5)各17点を直接確認して転記し、印刷された4桁座標を保持します。表Vの格子上の主渦位置(.6172,.7344)を別に比較します。丸めを含む有限格子数値表で、厳密な連続解でも今回のソルバー出力でもありません。
assumptions.en: Unit square,Re100,unit top lid and stationary other walls. Transcribe17points each of u(.5,y) and v(x,.5) after direct inspection of original TablesI/II Re100 columns, preserving printed four-decimal coordinates. Separately compare the grid primary vortex(.6172,.7344) from TableV. These rounded finite-grid numerical tables are neither continuum exact values nor outputs from the present solver.

note.ja: Re=100・3固定格子の教育用検査です。蓋と側壁の角に速度の不連続があり、角の速度は静止側を優先します。Ghia値は丸めた数値参照で厳密解ではなく、4桁座標をそのまま使います。高Re・乱流・原著アルゴリズムの再現・キャビティ圧力を検証したとは主張しません。
note.en: Educational Re100 checks on three fixed grids. Lid/sidewall corner velocities are discontinuous; stationary corners take precedence. Ghia values are rounded numerical references, not an exact solution, and printed four-decimal coordinates are preserved. No high-Re, turbulence, original-algorithm reproduction or cavity-pressure validation is claimed.

title.ja: LBMのRe100キャビティ：実2D場とGhia中心線
title.en: LBM Re100 cavity: actual2D fields and Ghia centerlines

references.formula: Ghia1982Re100 centerline tables and primary-vortex location; these are rounded numerical data,not an exact whole-field solution.

assumptions.ja: 物理単位正方形、蓋U1、ν.01、Re100。N24/32/48、格子蓋速度.04、dt=.04/N。3壁静止、上壁右向き、同時上面/側面crossingは静止側を優先。初期rho1・静止。
assumptions.en: Physical unit square, lid1, viscosity.01, Re100; N24/32/48, lattice lid.04, dt=.04/N. Three stationary walls/rightward lid; stationary side owns a simultaneous top/side link. Initialrho1/rest.

note.ja: 物理単位正方形、蓋U1、ν.01、Re100。N24/32/48、格子蓋速度.04、dt=.04/N。3壁静止、上壁右向き、同時上面/側面crossingは静止側を優先。初期rho1・静止。
note.en: Physical unit square, lid1, viscosity.01, Re100; N24/32/48, lattice lid.04, dt=.04/N. Three stationary walls/rightward lid; stationary side owns a simultaneous top/side link. Initialrho1/rest.

reference_note.ja: 21単体検査と群全体94判定を事前固定。原著の表I/II（印刷398–399頁）を直接確認して転記した17点ずつへ線形補間し、最細の各速度最大誤差≤.03、細分化で減少、定常残差≤1e−7を検査します。表Vの主渦位置・壁値・Poisson残差・離散発散も確認します。
reference_note.en: Freeze21 pytest checks and94group gates. Linearly interpolate to17points per velocity transcribed after direct visual reading of original TablesI/II, printed398–399. Require finest component maximum errors≤.03, refinement decrease and steady residual≤1e−7. Also check primary-vortex grid location from TableV, wall values, Poisson residual and discrete divergence.

method_note.ja: ωt+uωx+vωy=νΔωを中央差分とHeun法で進め、各段で−Δhψ=ωを非周期Dirichlet DSTで解きます。u=ψy,v=−ψx。局所一次のThom壁渦度を使用し、原著のCSI-MGと高次壁公式は実装していません。
method_note.en: Advance vorticity transport with centered differences and Heun. Each stage solves−Delta_h psi=omega using a nonperiodic Dirichlet DST, then formsu=psi_y,v=−psi_x. Use local first-order Thom wall vorticity; this is an independent method, not Ghia CSI-MG or its higher-order wall formula.

assumptions.ja: 物理単位正方形、蓋U1、ν.01、Re100。N24/32/48、格子蓋速度.04、dt=.04/N。3壁静止、上壁右向き、同時上面/側面crossingは静止側を優先。初期rho1・静止。
assumptions.en: Physical unit square, lid1, viscosity.01, Re100; N24/32/48, lattice lid.04, dt=.04/N. Three stationary walls/rightward lid; stationary side owns a simultaneous top/side link. Initialrho1/rest.

limits.ja: 有限Machでの3格子教育例。Ghiaは丸めた独立数値参照で厳密解ではありません。蓋角は不連続で点ごとの二次精度や高Reを主張せず、他手法の既存キャビティ結果を本LBMの成功に流用しません。標準C++17compilerが必要です。
limits.en: Three finite-Mach educational grids. Ghia is a rounded independent numerical reference, not exact. No pointwise corner order/high-Re claim or borrowed success from another cavity solver. A standard C++17compiler is required.

reference_note.ja: 各群22pytestと37判定。60k/80k/120k整数stepsでt*=100へ進み90/95/100を保存。最細u/v中心線最大誤差.03、主渦距離.06、95→100相対L2変化2e-4、質量・壁込み運動量ledgerを事前固定します。

caption.en: Computed finest manufactured-flow streamlines and velocity error, using the same Thom closure as the cavity without exact wall-vorticity injection.

equation_note.ja: 単位正方形、ν=.01、17/33/65点、ψ=8f(x)f(y),f(z)=z²(1−z)²。全壁で非浸透・滑りなし。渦度外力は連続方程式から解析的に導出し、全壁にキャビティと同じThom条件を使用します。厳密壁渦度は注入しません。

name.ja: 非周期壁面の製造解：速度・剪断・圧力演算子
name.en: Nonperiodic wall MMS: velocity, shear and pressure operator

latex: p_\star=x^2+y^2+\sin(\pi x)\sin(\pi y),\quad -\Delta p_\star=-4+2\pi^2\sin(\pi x)\sin(\pi y),\quad p|_{\partial\Omega}=p_\star

note.ja: キャビティと同じ壁条件付き2Dソルバーに解析外力を与え、速度と流れ関数の格子収束、壁渦度・壁剪断の誤差を測ります。別の非零Dirichlet圧力製造解でPoisson・勾配の境界演算子も検査します。

title.ja: 壁面製造解：多項式速度と独立した圧力演算子
title.en: Wall manufactured solution: polynomial velocity and separate pressure operator

references.formula: psi*=8 f(x)f(y),f(z)=z²(1−z)²; s=u*omega*_x+v*omega*_y−nu*Delta omega*. Separate: p_op=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y).

assumptions.ja: 単位正方形・ν.01・滑りなし、ψ*=8x²(1−x)²y²(1−y)²、u*=ψ*y、v*=−ψ*x、ω*=−Δψ*。連続の渦度式からs=u*ω*x+v*ω*y−νΔω*を構成し、独立の係数行列微分と照合します。PDE計算の壁渦度はキャビティと同じThom式で、厳密値を注入しません。p_op=x²+y²+sinπx sinπyの非零Dirichlet Poisson・勾配は別の演算子問題で、流れに結合した圧力やキャビティ圧力ではありません。
assumptions.en: Unit square,viscosity.01,no-slip,psi*=8x²(1−x)²y²(1−y)²,u*=psi*_y,v*=−psi*_x,omega*=−Delta psi*. Construct s=u*omega*_x+v*omega*_y−nu*Delta omega* from the continuous vorticity PDE, qualified by independent tensor-coefficient differentiation. PDE wall vorticity uses the same Thom closure as the cavity without exact injection. Nonzero-Dirichlet Poisson/gradient for p_op=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y) is a separate operator problem, not coupled flow or cavity pressure.

note.ja: Thomの壁渦度局所打切りは一次で、壁剪断の二次精度は主張せず観測次数を示します。流れ関数の発展では圧力を消去するためゲージは該当しません。圧力診断は独立した演算子製造問題であり、キャビティの圧力・応力境界やMAC射影の検証ではありません。多項式の別微分は独立な流体ソルバーとの比較とは区別します。
note.en: Thom wall vorticity has first-order local truncation; publish observed shear rates without promising second order. Pressure is eliminated from streamfunction evolution, so a pressure gauge is inapplicable. The separate operator MMS does not verify cavity pressure, traction boundaries or MAC projection. Independent polynomial differentiation is distinct from comparison with an independent flow solver.

reference_note.ja: ψと速度の最細刻み対の次数≥1.7、誤差減少・絶対誤差、実際の壁渦度と速度勾配剪断の誤差減少を検査します。圧力演算子はp次数≥1.8、全体と境界の勾配次数≥1.7。独立多項式照合5項目、全壁値、真の定常残差、非周期Poisson残差も記録します。
reference_note.en: Require finest-pair psi/velocity orders≥1.7, decreasing and bounded errors, and decreasing actual wall-vorticity/velocity-gradient shear errors. Separate pressure orders must be≥1.8 forp and≥1.7 for full/boundary gradients. Record five independent polynomial-reference checks, four-wall values, true steady residual and nonperiodic Poisson residual.

method_note.ja: 共通の中央差分・Heun・非周期Dirichlet DST Poissonを使用します。多項式の明示微分と、独立な係数行列の微分を照合します。別途p=x²+y²+sinπx sinπyの非零Dirichlet Poisson問題を解き、内部中央差分・壁上の二次片側差分勾配を検査します。

Separately solve nonzero-Dirichlet Poisson forp=x²+y²+sin(pi*x)sin(pi*y), checking central interior and second-order one-sided boundary gradients.

The two motions are conditions of one transported-circle-interface problem.

title.en: Relativistic symmetric collision: specialized two-shock Taub reference

assumptions.ja: c=1、γ=5/3、ρ=1、p=.1、左右v=±.3、B=0。区間[0,1]、初期不連続x=.5、t=.3、96/192/384セル。衝撃波が端へ届く前の外挿境界です。Taub断熱式と相対速度式の圧力根から静止した同一星状態と衝撃波速度を求め、保存変数の区分一定厳密場をセル積分します。接触面は退化し、一般三波Riemannソルバーではありません。
assumptions.en: c=1,gamma5/3,rho1,p.1,opposite normal v±.3,B0. Domain[0,1], initial jump .5,t=.3,96/192/384 cells. Constant extrapolation boundaries before shocks reach endpoints. Solve the pressure root from Taub adiabat and relative-velocity relations for the identical resting star states and shock speeds, then integrate the piecewise-constant exact conserved field over cells. The contact degenerates; this is not a general three-wave Riemann solver.

note.ja: 独自の穏やかな対称入力で、接触面は同じ静止状態へ退化します。一般三波Riemann解、高Lorentz因子、原著の数値入力は検証しません。Eは静止質量を含み、保存量の厳密セル平均と比較します。
note.en: Custom mild symmetric input; contact degenerates to identical resting states. No general three-wave Riemann,extreme-Lorentz-factor or original-paper numerical-input reproduction claim. E includes rest mass; compare exact conserved cell means.

reference_note.ja: 群全体25pytest、6固定計算、110判定と参照6検査を事前固定。全量境界収支、各段・再構築面の正値と亜光速、D/E細分化、星領域圧力、衝撃波位置、反射対称性を検査。実際の最終状態を独立なSRHD圧力根と流束でも照合します。
reference_note.en: Predeclare25 pytest tests,six runs,110 group gates and six reference qualifiers. Check all-component boundary budgets, stage/face admissibility,D/E refinement,star pressure,shock positions and reflection. Compare actual final states with independent scalar-pressure SRHD recovery and flux.

method_note.ja: 同じ7保存量RMHD演算子をB=0で使い、MUSCL/minmod・因果的HLL波速±1・SSPRK33で進めます。Z=ρhW²の物理根を保護付きNewton法で復元し、残差と保存量往復を確認します。
method_note.en: Use the shared seven-component RMHD operator at B=0 with primitive MUSCL/minmod, causal HLL bounds±1 and SSPRK33. Safeguarded Newton recovers the physical Z=rho h W² root; check residual and full conserved-state roundtrip.

scope.ja: 相対論的な対称衝突を、独立なTaub関係から得る厳密な保存量セル平均と比較し、実際の1D時空間場を保存します。
scope.en: Compare a relativistic symmetric collision with independent exact Taub-based conserved cell means; save actual1D x–t fields.

name.en: SRMHD finite-amplitude circularly polarized Alfvén wave

caption.ja: 最細格子の実際の横磁場Byの1D x–t図。5保存時刻を使い、計算は完全な磁気結合を含みます。
caption.en: Actual finest-grid transverse By in1D x–t from five stored times; the solver includes full magnetic coupling.

formula: \partial_t\boldsymbol B-\nabla\times(\boldsymbol v\times\boldsymbol B)=0,\quad \nabla\cdot\boldsymbol B=0,\quad h=1+\frac{\Gamma p}{(\Gamma-1)\rho}

note.ja: c=4π=1、平坦時空・理想電気伝導・γ則EOSです。bμは流体静止系磁場4ベクトル。全磁気応力と誘導を含む7保存量を1Dで進め、原始変数は完全なRMHDのZ根で復元します。GRMHDとは区別します。
note.en: Flat spacetime,ideal conductivity,gamma-law EOS,c=4pi=1; b^mu is the comoving magnetic four-vector. The1D solver evolves seven conserved variables with full magnetic stress and induction, using coupled RMHD Z recovery. Distinguish it from GRMHD.

equation_note.ja: 平坦時空、c=4π=1、γ=4/3、ρ=p=Bx=η=1、vx=0の厳密族。原著2π周期を単位区間へ写し、64/128/256セル、周期境界、t=1/vA。Bxは1次元で固定します。
equation_note.en: Flat spacetime,c=4pi=1,gamma4/3,rho=p=Bx=eta1, exact-family vx0. Rescale the original2pi period to a unit domain;64/128/256 cells,periodic,t=1/vA. Normal Bx is fixed in1D.

name.en: SRMHD finite-amplitude circularly polarized Alfvén wave

latex: \mathbf v=\frac{\mathbf S+(\mathbf S\cdot\mathbf B)\mathbf B/Z}{Z+B^2},\quad p=\frac{\Gamma-1}{\Gamma}(Z/W^2-\rho)

note.ja: 完全な磁気応力と誘導を含むSRMHDで非線形有限振幅波を1周期進め、厳密セル平均、位相、振幅と細分化を検査します。
note.en: Evolve a nonlinear finite-amplitude wave for one period with full SRMHD magnetic stress and induction; check exact cell means,phase,amplitude and refinement.

title.ja: SRMHD円偏波：有限振幅厳密族と独立テンソル積分
title.en: SRMHD circular wave: finite-amplitude exact family and independent tensor integration

assumptions.ja: 平坦時空、c=4π=1、γ=4/3、ρ=p=Bx=η=1、vx=0の厳密族。原著2π周期を単位区間へ写し、64/128/256セル、周期境界、t=1/vA。Bxは1次元で固定します。非線形Alfvén速度の閉じた式を使い、点の原始変数から独立なストレステンソルで保存量と流束を作り、Gauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で確認します。原著の2π周期を単位区間へ移しています。
assumptions.en: Flat spacetime,c=4pi=1,gamma4/3,rho=p=Bx=eta1, exact-family vx0. Rescale the original2pi period to a unit domain;64/128/256 cells,periodic,t=1/vA. Normal Bx is fixed in1D. Use the closed nonlinear Alfven-speed formula. Independently form conserved quantities/fluxes from point primitives through the stress tensor; qualify Gauss integration and complex-step PDE residuals. Rescale the original2pi period to the unit interval.

note.ja: 原著の厳密解族を独立な低次法で計算し、ECHO法や原著誤差表は再現しません。一般RMHD衝撃波、極端な磁化・Lorentz因子、GR、抵抗MHD、多次元磁場発散制御は対象外。図は実際の1D時空間場です。
note.en: Use the original exact family with an independent lower-order operator; no ECHO-algorithm or error-table reproduction. Generic RMHD shocks,extreme magnetization/Lorentz factors,GR,resistive MHD and multidimensional divergence control are outside scope. Figures show actual1D x–t fields.

reference_note.ja: 非線形分散式、独立テンソルのGauss積分と複素段階PDE残差で参照を確認。全7量保存と全段物理性、途中誤差、最細相対L1≤.04、位相≤.03、振幅≤.04、観測次数≥1.5を事前固定します。
reference_note.en: Qualify nonlinear dispersion,independent tensor Gauss means and complex-step PDE residuals. Predeclare all-seven-component conservation,stage admissibility,intermediate errors,finest relative L1≤.04,phase≤.03,amplitude≤.04 and observed order≥1.5.

method_note.ja: D・運動量3成分・全エネルギー・横磁場2成分の全7変数を同じMUSCL/minmod–HLL–SSPRK33で進めます。磁場は動的に結合し、完全なRMHDのZ根で原始変数へ復元します。
method_note.en: Evolve all seven variables D,three momenta,total E and two transverse magnetic fields with the shared MUSCL/minmod–HLL–SSPRK33 operator. Magnetic dynamics are coupled; primitive recovery solves the full RMHD Z root.

Four-shift Student-t intervals are nominal conditional summaries; neither coverage of the exact rate nor total error is established.

assumptions.ja: 2D空間に3D角度測度を用い、c=1の軸に整列した光線を扱います。実際の符号付き角度輸送と非線形の閉じたM1方程式をともに進めます。解析特性線の参照はRTE/S_Nに適用し、M1解全体の厳密参照とはしません。

note.ja: 6軸は整列beam用で一般角度収束ではありません。反向beamのM1差はモデル情報損失として示し、角度輸送への収束を要求しません。相対論・気体流体・多周波RHDではありません。
note.en: Six aligned directions do not demonstrate general angular convergence. The M1 opposing-beam mismatch is expected information loss and is not required to converge to angular transport. No relativistic, gas-dynamical or multifrequency radiation hydrodynamics is implemented.

name.ja: 放射輸送・モーメント法

method_note.ja: 風上角度FV／M1のRusanovとSSPRK2。吸収は保存ledger付き指数分割。6軸重み1/6、単位beamのnodal強度6、Pzzと全3Dtraceを保持。floor/projectionはしません。 旧c1 Rusanovの横拡散による3不合格を保持し、一般状態の方向別Jacobian固有値・LF円錐分割・法線flux比の最大を一面係数に採用。全ghost面と台帳へ同じfluxを使い、真空と既存許容丸め域の速度だけ1へ拡張して回数・最大超過を記録します。U/Pの投影や純beam特例branchはありません。
method_note.en: Conservative upwind angular finite volumes or M1 Rusanov fluxes with SSPRK2; exponential absorption with a separate deposited-energy ledger. Six axis directions have weight1/6; a unit beam has nodal intensity6. Retain Pzz and the full3D trace. No positive floor or cone projection. The revised general directional local-LF coefficient is the maximum of endpoint spectral radii,an independently derived cone-splitting bound,and normal reduced flux. Use the same face rule on all ghost boundaries and in the ledger. Explicit speed-only vacuum/allowed-roundoff extension1 is counted; no U/P projection or special beam branch. Preserve the original c1 transverse-diffusion failure.

name.ja: 線形Maxwell電磁場（真空・誘電体）
name.en: Linear Maxwell fields in vacuum and dielectrics

note.en: The representative equations describe three-dimensional linear electromagnetics. This implementation is restricted to a z-invariant, genuinely two-dimensional Yee cylinder problem with Ez/Hx/Hy.

equation_note.ja: c=ε0=μ0=1。無限円柱のEz偏光、半径0.25、比誘電率2.25、真空波長1。6×6領域と4辺PML、明示的な節点階段状形状です。

name.en: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder

note.en: Evolve the actual two-dimensional scattered fields and compare closed-contour Poynting power with an independent cylindrical series.

title.ja: 誘電体円柱の外部級数と散乱幅
title.en: Exterior series and scattering width of a dielectric cylinder

assumptions.ja: 無損失無限円柱、Ez偏光、c=ε0=μ0=1、半径0.25、ε=2.25、真空波長1。解析場は厳密な円の外部だけです。
assumptions.en: Lossless infinite cylinder, Ez polarization, c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, radius 0.25, epsilon = 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The analytical field is exterior to the exact circle.

note.ja: Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。
note.en: This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.

reference_note.ja: 12/18/24点/波長、32周期の過渡除去と8周期の計測。2本の閉曲線、前後4周期、同じ全時間を進めた半振幅phasorと5保存時刻の真空対照を検査し、円柱級数の散乱幅と外部場を照合します。
reference_note.en: Use 12/18/24 points per wavelength, 32 burn-in periods and 8 measured periods. Check two contours, consecutive four-period windows, half-amplitude phasors after a complete repeated evolution, and a vacuum control at the five saved times. Compare scattering width and exterior fields with the cylindrical series.

method_note.ja: Yeeの散乱場を局所分極contrastの厳密な離散入射差分で励起します。EとHはそれぞれの整数・半時刻でFourier集計し、Hの4点補間後に物理流束を積分します。
method_note.en: Advance the scattered Yee fields with an exact discrete incident difference on the polarization-contrast support. Accumulate E and H at their own integer and half times, then integrate physical power after four-point native-face collocation.

formula: \partial_t\mathbf P=\mathbf J,\quad\partial_t\mathbf J=f\mathbf E-\omega_0^2\mathbf P-\gamma\mathbf J,\quad f=\Delta\varepsilon\omega_0^2

Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation.

assumptions.en: Vacuum surroundings, ky = 4, slab [4, 5], epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Compare omega = 5.1/6/6.9 for both s = Ez and p = Hz.

Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

reference_note.ja: s/p各3解像度の物質・真空12進行からω=5.1/6/6.9を測定。独立な有限窓の真空幾何級数、複素Fresnel係数、直接体積散逸、全stepのPEC収支と末尾を検査します。
reference_note.en: Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails.

method_note.ja: 単一ky Yee空間演算と局所の陰的中点Lorentz ADE。p偏光の両電場に分極を結合し、同格子の真空波束で入射・伝播位相を除きます。直接Ohmic・物質減衰仕事と修正エネルギーを別々に集計します。

Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy.

title.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu shooting・接線・随伴参照
title.en: Discrete Bratu shooting, tangent and adjoint references near a fold

references.formula: F_h=A_hu-\lambda e^u=0,\quad J_hs=e^u,\quad J_h^\top p=h u,\quad g=0.05\lambda+p^Te^u;\quad q^T(s_D-\widehat s)=p_D^T(r_s-r_D)+r_{pD}^T(s_D-\widehat s),\quad b=e^u,\ q=hu,\ r_s=b-J_h\widehat s,\ r_D=b-J_hs_D,\ r_{pD}=q-J_h^Tp_D.

assumptions.ja: 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。
assumptions.en: One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference.

note.ja: 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. note.ja: 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
note.en: Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

reference_note.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
reference_note.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

method_note.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
method_note.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

assumptions.ja: 1D零Dirichlet Bratuの31内点と5観測を用いる2係数逆問題。既存合成観測を再利用し、物理boxはa∈[1,2.8],b∈[-.5,.5]。目的正則化γ、LM減衰μ、変数尺度は別です。
assumptions.en: A two-coefficient inverse problem uses 31 interior nodes and five observations of the one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet Bratu model. Reuse existing synthetic data; the physical box is a in[1,2.8],b in[-.5,.5]. Objective regularization gamma, LM damping mu and variable scaling are distinct.

note.ja: 小さい滑らかな分枝の局所比較。SciPy最適化ライブラリは参照側でも共有し、大域最小・一意性を証明しません。LMに箱制約があるとは説明しません。
note.en: A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method.

Gate final state residuals, physical gradient or projected gradient, objective gaps, data-only SVD and active bounds. method_note.en: Original SVD least-squares GN/LM, the retained projected-gradient solver, SciPy TRF and explicitly unbounded SciPy LM. A canonical lower/upper box is explicitly adapted to the legacy per-parameter intervals.

name.en: BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima

caption.ja: 実際のRosenbrock反復点と解析目的関数の等高線。3つの固定初期値・4手法を示し、全問題での収束保証ではありません。 図の座標は有限次元の変数・反復・診断で、物理空間の次元やPDE境界を表しません。
caption.en: Actual Rosenbrock iterates on analytic objective contours for three fixed starts and four methods; this is not a general convergence guarantee. Plot axes describe finite-dimensional variables, iterations or diagnostics, not a physical spatial dimension or PDE boundary.

name.ja: 有限次元代数最適化と既知最小点
name.en: Finite-dimensional algebraic optimization and known minima

formula: \nabla f(x_*)=0\quad\text{(necessary for a smooth unconstrained local minimum)}

note.ja: 8次元SPD二次関数と2変数Rosenbrockの無次元代数最適化です。物理空間・PDE境界を持たず、既知最小点と局所反復作用を比較します。
note.en: Dimensionless algebraic optimization of an eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and a two-variable Rosenbrock function. There is no physical spatial domain or PDE boundary; compare known minima and local iterative actions.

equation_note.ja: 無次元の非有界代数的最適化。既知の解析最小点を持ち、物理PDEの境界条件はありません。
equation_note.en: Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization with known analytic minima; there is no physical PDE boundary condition.

name.en: BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima

latex: H_+=(I-\rho s y^T)H(I-\rho y s^T)+\rho s s^T

note.ja: 8次元SPD二次関数と3初期値のRosenbrockを用い、曲率・strong Wolfe・現在の有限記憶作用を検査します。
note.en: An eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts test curvature, strong Wolfe conditions and the current finite-memory action.

title.ja: 既知最小点と現在の有限記憶作用に対する解析参照
title.en: Analytic known minima and the current limited-memory action

references.formula: f_Q=\tfrac12(x-x_*)^TA(x-x_*),\quad x_*=(1,-1,\ldots)^T;\quad f_R=100(y-x^2)^2+(1-x)^2,\quad (x_*,y_*)=(1,1);\quad H_+=(I-\rho sy^T)H(I-\rho ys^T)+\rho ss^T.

assumptions.ja: 無次元・非有界の代数最適化。8次元SPD二次関数とRosenbrockの3初期値を用い、L-BFGSは現在の最大3組だけを保持します。物理PDE境界条件はありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization uses an eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts. L-BFGS retains only the current last three pairs. There is no physical PDE boundary condition.

note.ja: 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。
note.en: No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

reference_note.ja: 16固定fit、解析的な最小点・勾配、各受理stepのstrong Wolfeと解像された正曲率、BFGSの対称SPD、L-BFGS作用差を判定。保持組とoracle稠密行列の記憶を分離。
reference_note.en: Sixteen fixed fits check analytic minima/gradients, strong Wolfe and resolved positive curvature at every accepted step, symmetric SPD BFGS matrices and L-BFGS action defects. Retained-pair and dense-oracle storage are reported separately.

method_note.ja: 独自逆BFGSとベクトルだけの2-loop L-BFGS（3組）。独立な小稠密oracleは現在γ₀Iから現在保持する組だけを古い順に再生。SciPy BFGS/L-BFGS-B（bounds=None）を別実装として比較。
method_note.en: Original inverse-BFGS and vector-only two-loop L-BFGS with three pairs. A separate small dense oracle replays only currently retained pairs from the current gamma0 I. SciPy BFGS and unbounded L-BFGS-B are distinct software companions.

title.ja: 有限γ経路と局所線形雑音伝播のBratu参照
title.en: Bratu references for finite gamma paths and local linear noise propagation

references.formula: G=K^TWK+\gamma I,\quad C_\gamma=G^{-1}K^TW\Sigma WKG^{-T},\quad b_\gamma=-\gamma G^{-1}(\theta_*-\theta_0).

assumptions.ja: 31内点、5観測、W=I/5、Σ=σ²I。既存の31/1023格子観測を再利用します。雑音の標準偏差σは1e-4と1e-3で、独立な基底雑音は2 seedです。尺度・格子文脈をまたぐ比較は同じ雑音ベクトルを共有します。γは固定5点です。
assumptions.en: Use 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Reuse existing 31/1023-grid observations. The noise standard deviations sigma are 1e-4 and 1e-3; two seeds provide independent base noises, while scaled/grid-context variants are paired. Gamma has five fixed values.

note.ja: 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
note.en: Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.

reference_note.ja: 42 fitの最終残差・物理KKT・実行完了、選択規則、明示的2×2代数による固定線形モデルの共分散・偏り・モデル差応答、対称PSDを検査。

method_note.en: Select the largest admissible gamma using 1.05 times the realized noise norm only after the full gamma path qualifies. Incomplete paths and complete paths with no admissible gamma are distinct. Four-point L-curves are descriptive diagnostics.

reference_note.en: Qualify the Jacobi family against two independent angular ODE runs, then compare states, exact constraint laws and energy/work budgets. A separately qualified Jacobi family and angular DOP853 reference support 74 main decisions. Finite-C centered identities, two-delta reduced-map diagnostics and position-pair versus full-state reversals are distinct.

method_note.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。
method_note.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages. Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.

limits.ja: 中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。
limits.en: The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.

reference_note.ja: 116主判定。独立の結合固有モード解析、保存係数Decimal80/120・Fraction写像、段階別γ8丸め上界を区別。理想πのJordan構造は有理恒等式で別確認。 各probeは現在保存した係数hexからDecimal80/120を評価し、6精度軌道はDecimal80を用います。
reference_note.en: The 116 main decisions distinguish independent coupled normal modes, Decimal80/120 and Fraction frozen-coefficient maps, and stagewise gamma8 roundoff allowances. Ideal-pi Jordan structure is checked separately by rational identities. Each probe uses the current saved coefficient hex for its own Decimal80/120 actions; six accuracy actions use Decimal80.
